parts.text: Which set of steps is correct?

options.text: Clean the tip, place the tip under the tongue, keep the mouth closed, and read after the beep.
Place the display screen under the tongue and wait for the beep.
Put the tip under the tongue but keep the mouth open the whole time.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Imran feels slightly unwell. He will measure his body temperature with a digital clinical thermometer.

part_answers.answer: Hygiene needs a clean tip; placement needs the tip under the tongue with the mouth closed until the beep.

teacher.key_rationale: A digital clinical thermometer reading needs a clean tip, placement under the tongue with the mouth closed, and reading after the beep—not the display under the tongue or an open mouth.
